evals.prompt: I added graceful shutdown handling to our Gin service's main.go and tested it locally with `go run .` - it works. Is that enough to confirm it works once deployed to Lambda?
evals.expected_output: Flags that the local http.Server path and the Lambda/serverless adapter path are genuinely different code paths, and that graceful shutdown logic tested only locally may not apply or run at all in the deployed serverless path.

assertions.text: Flags the local vs serverless path as genuinely different
States local testing alone doesn't confirm deployed behavior

evals.prompt: Our Go build is failing in CI with a version-related error. go.mod says go 1.24. Should I just update the CI config to use Go 1.24 and call it fixed?
evals.expected_output: Recommends checking all places the Go version is declared (go.mod, Dockerfile, CI config, README) before assuming go.mod is the single source of truth, since they can disagree.

assertions.text: Recommends checking multiple version sources, not just go.mod
